title: 第122章 邬七巧中毒第121章 火纹卷
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“师父，这件是好东西？”
邬七巧看到火纹卷，第一感觉就是那种应该扔进垃圾堆的那种。
“我原先看重的是修复后它的能力，但到了手里才发现，我这是走了狗屎运。”
“师父，什么是狗屎运？”
石泉水神识浸入火纹卷，里面竟然藏了一间洞府。
正常的储物袋，哪怕是仙品级别的，都无法容纳洞府。
不是储物袋不够大，受制于天地法则很难做到。
火纹卷，哪怕只是残破的很，里面依然保存着洞府，足以见得此卷并非凡物。
神识穿透洞府周围的禁制，里面赫然是一仙界。
仙界被很强的禁制包裹。
“主人，刚才有人一直在出价，会不会知晓此宝？”
“有可能，但若有人早知道何必来此地购买。
不过，或许此人刚刚才发现玄机。
七巧。”
石泉水立马察觉有一道很强的神识强行破开房间。
“师父！”
邬七巧也感知到神识。
此房间就有屏蔽神识的法阵和禁制。
就算是化神期要破开房间都十分困难。
“此人轻易破开房间禁制，实力恐怕还在我之上。

跨出此地后务必小心。”
石泉水感觉此人有可能是卷中仙界的仙人。
或许转世后千辛万苦才找到此卷，结果被他捷足先登。
“此人......难道是仙问宫的？”
“不是，若是仙问宫，其财力不会只有这些，总之，此人遇到此人要万分当心。”
神识来的快去的也快。
石泉水又将神识浸入洞府之内。
刚才一次太过匆忙，并没有发现一些玄机。
“主人，果然如此。
火纹卷内的仙界是有人在无奈之时才将仙界封印于其中。
刚才那人或许就是施法之人。”
“如此一来，里面的秘密没拍卖者发现就有解释地方。”
“主人，若如此，只要顺着这一条线索一路倒推，说不定就能找到他。”
“没这么麻烦，此人知道东西在我手里，迟早会找上门来。
content_en:
"Master, is this a good thing?"
When Wu Qiqiao saw the Fire Pattern Scroll, his first impression was that it should be thrown into the trash.
"What I originally valued was its ability after repair, but when I got it in my hands, I realized that I was just unlucky."
"Master, what is shitty luck?"
The spiritual consciousness of the stone spring water was immersed in the fire pattern scroll, and there was actually a cave hidden inside.
Normal storage bags, even those at the Immortal level, cannot accommodate the cave.
It’s not that the storage bag is not big enough, it is difficult to do it due to the laws of heaven and earth.
Even if the Fire Emblem Scroll is only very damaged, there is still a cave inside, which is enough to show that this scroll is not an extraordinary object.
Divine consciousness penetrated the restrictions around the cave, and there was an immortal world inside.
The fairy world is surrounded by strong restrictions.
"Master, someone has been bidding just now. Does he know about this treasure?"
“It’s possible, but if someone knew earlier why would they come here to buy.
However, maybe this person just discovered the mystery.
Qiqiao. "
Shi Quanshui immediately noticed that there was a strong spiritual consciousness forcibly breaking open the room.
"Master!"
Wu Qiqiao also sensed divine consciousness.
This room has magic circles and restrictions that shield spiritual consciousness.
It is very difficult to break through the room even in the transformation stage.
"This person can easily break through the room restrictions, and his strength is probably higher than mine.
Be careful when you step out of here. "
Shi Quanshui felt that this person might be an immortal from the fairy world in the volume.
Perhaps after reincarnation, he worked hard to find this volume, but he got there first.
"Is this person... from Xianwen Palace?"
"No, if it is Xianwen Palace, its financial resources will not be limited to this. In short, this person should be extremely careful when meeting this person."
Divine consciousness comes and goes quickly.
The stone spring water immersed spiritual consciousness into the cave.
I was in too much of a hurry just now and didn't discover any mystery.
"Master, it is indeed so.
The fairy world in the Fire Emblem Scroll was sealed in by someone when they had no choice but to do so.
That person just now might be the one who cast the spell. "
"In this way, the secret inside can be explained without the auctioneer discovering it."
"Master, if that's the case, as long as you follow this clue all the way back, you might be able to find him."
"It's not that troublesome. This person knows that I have the things in my hands and will come to my door sooner or later.
